svg.title: The active model scores a fixed-K tree topology and clone-specific local-fraction vector, while SMC stores and explores only T plus eta; SNV assignment and genotype/multiplicity uncertainty are marginalized in the likelihood.

text.data-meaning: title states the combined model and inference definition

svg.text: Model + SMC inference: state, marginalization, outputs

text.data-meaning: subtitle states the active runtime boundary

svg.text: Active contract: particle state = T + η; zᵢ / gᵢ are marginalized in the likelihood

rect.data-meaning: left panel groups model definitions and the collapsed candidate score
categorical badge identifies the model panel

svg.text: Fixed K; inputs are not state.

rect.data-meaning: card shows the two persistent biological particle-state variables

text.data-meaning: candidate state contains topology and local fractions only

image.data-meaning: illustrative candidate state with one rooted topology and a positive eta simplex

rect.data-meaning: card distinguishes derived CCF from persistent state

text.data-meaning: CCF equals a clone local fraction plus descendants local fractions

svg.text: T determines descendants; η determines local mass.

rect.data-meaning: card groups fixed observed inputs used only by the emission

text.data-meaning: inputs are not sampled particle-state variables

path.data-meaning: arrow links persistent state to the derived CCF definition
arrow directs model state and input context to the marginalized likelihood layer

rect.data-meaning: card defines likelihood-side latent variables and their marginalization

text.data-meaning: z_i denotes the latent clone assignment of SNV i

svg.text: zᵢ: clone assignment for SNV i

text.data-meaning: g_i denotes the latent CN-aware genotype and multiplicity candidate of SNV i
latent uncertainty is integrated rather than fixed in a particle
collapsed per-site likelihood sums assignment and genotype candidates

svg.text: P(Dᵢ|T,η) = Σ_z η_z · Σ_g P(g|Cᵢ) · Binomial(ALTᵢ | totalᵢ, ξᵢ(g,φ_z))

rect.data-meaning: card presents the collapsed model score that SMC receives

svg.text: Collapsed posterior score passed to SMC

text.data-meaning: SMC scores T and eta after z and g are marginalized
collapsed score explicitly excludes z and g as persistent state dimensions

svg.text: zᵢ / gᵢ summed out; persistent state is T + η.

rect.data-meaning: right panel groups active annealed SMC operations and posterior summaries
categorical badge identifies the inference panel

svg.text: Each particle is one T + η.

rect.data-meaning: card shows a finite SMC population of illustrative topology-plus-eta particle states

text.data-meaning: candidate images are categorical illustrations rather than posterior estimates

svg.text: Each tree / η is an illustrative candidate state.

rect.data-meaning: card shows the score, resampling, and rejuvenation steps of annealed SMC
model scoring step applies the collapsed posterior score to each particle

text.data-meaning: model score uses the collapsed likelihood

rect.data-meaning: resampling step retains high-weight particle lineages when ESS is low
rejuvenation step proposes topology and eta changes while preserving the same particle-state definition

path.data-meaning: feedback loop indicates repeated annealing updates through beta stages
arrow passes candidate particles into SMC scoring

rect.data-meaning: card shows that SMC retains a population of posterior-supported particles rather than a unique tree

svg.text: terminal resampling → many equal-weight posterior particles

text.data-meaning: posterior does not imply a unique true tree
particles remain defined by topology and eta

svg.text: Each retained particle remains T + η.

path.data-meaning: arrow carries completed particle population to terminal posterior particles

svg.text: Posterior outputs summarized from retained particles

rect.data-meaning: output card for topology edge support
output card for eta-derived CCF summaries
output card for SNV assignment posterior summaries
output card for multiplicity posterior summaries
